name: Differentiable CT Execution Model
definition: A software framework providing per-view CT geometry, cell-constant point-ray Siddon projection, a matched adjoint, first-order geometry and surface derivatives, and differentiable analytical reconstruction with its own discrete transpose. Execution extends across multiple GPUs, CPU, or disk storage via spatial, view, and pixel block partitions.
summary: The Differentiable CT Execution Model is a PyTorch framework for differentiable computed tomography that integrates cell-constant attenuation along rays, setting itself apart by providing native first-order geometry derivatives for trainable acquisition parameters.
